import re


def slugify(text):
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s-]", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", text.strip())
    return text

def slugify(text):
    """Convert text to a URL-friendly slug.

    Lowercases the input, strips punctuation, and replaces whitespace
    runs with a single hyphen.

    Examples:
        >>> slugify("Hello, World!")
        'hello-world'
        >>> slugify("Python 3.12 Rocks!")
        'python-312-rocks'
    """
    text = text.lower()
